openHealth reads the health data you choose to share through Health Connect, so your steps, heart rate, sleep, workouts, weight and body fat can appear in one place. Nothing is read until you grant it, and you can revoke any of it in Android settings at any time.

Read, only when you ask it to sync: steps, distance, calories burned, floors climbed, heart rate, resting heart rate, sleep, workouts, weight and body fat. openHealth never writes to Health Connect, so a value cannot be counted twice.
Your data stays in openHealth\'s encrypted storage on this phone. It is not sent to a server, shared with anyone or used for advertising. There is no analytics and no crash reporting.
